Speed 35 feet, climb 20 feet

Melee cap-strike (agile, finesse) 2d4 bludgeoning

Movement ignore plant and fungal difficult terrain

Green load allies who begin their turn adjacent to you gain 5 temporary Hit Points. Grey load each creature that ends its turn adjacent to you takes 1d6 poison (basic Fortitude against your Class DC).
